source: Transcribed from the physical cards (manual1/IMG_1270-1286); all 40 named, priced and typed. `built` says whether the old engine ran its effect.

cards.name: Brakes
cards.text: A Move 1 in your registers may be run as a Move 0.

cards.name: Chaos Theory
cards.text: Revealing SPAM in one of the first three registers earns you an Energy.

cards.name: Crab Legs
cards.text: A Move 1 alongside a rotate slides you sideways instead of turning.

cards.name: Deflector Shield
cards.text: Spend an Energy to shrug off every laser and weapon hit this register.

cards.name: Double-Barrel Laser
cards.text: Your main laser hits for one more.

cards.name: Drifting
cards.text: After a left rotate you may roll one square forward.

cards.name: Energy Conversion
cards.text: A board laser hit lets you shift one square either way.

cards.name: Firewall
cards.text: Falling into a pit costs you no damage cards.

cards.name: Flash Drive
cards.text: One extra programming card in every deal.

cards.name: Hover Unit
cards.text: You cross pits, and fall in only if you stop on one.

cards.name: Laser Kata
cards.text: A U-turn fires your main laser all four ways.

cards.name: Memory Cards
cards.text: Park cards here at the end of programming and take them back next round.

cards.name: Mini Howitzer
cards.text: Spend an Energy to fire for two and shove the target back.

cards.name: Modular Chassis
cards.text: Shove somebody and you may trade this card for one of theirs.

cards.name: Power Slide
cards.text: After a right rotate you may roll one square forward.

cards.name: Pressor Beam
cards.text: Fire this instead of your laser to shove the target one square away.

cards.name: Rail Gun
cards.text: Your main laser shoots through walls and robots alike.

cards.name: Ramming Gear
cards.text: A robot you shove takes a point of damage for it.

cards.name: Rear Laser
cards.text: A second laser fires backwards alongside your main one.

cards.name: Scrambler
cards.text: Fire this instead of your laser to swap the target's next card for a blind draw.

cards.name: Self-Diagnostics
cards.text: Reaching a checkpoint lets you tear one card out of your deck for good.

cards.name: Spam Filter
cards.text: You see the top card of your deck before you programme.

cards.name: Spiky
cards.text: Anything that moves or is shoved into you takes a point of damage.

cards.name: Tractor Beam
cards.text: Fire this instead of your laser to drag a distant target one square closer.

cards.name: Abort Switch
cards.text: Swap a register you have just turned over for a blind draw.

cards.name: All Aboard
cards.text: Run every conveyor once more, for you alone.

cards.name: Boink
cards.text: Hop to a free neighbouring square without turning.

cards.name: Calibration Protocol
cards.text: Scrap every damage card in your hand and draw that many fresh ones.

cards.name: Displacing Blast
cards.text: Fire this instead of your laser to send the target back to its reboot square.

cards.name: Lucky Booster
cards.text: Dig through the damage deck for a Haywire, and take it or bin it.

cards.name: Magnetic
cards.text: When a neighbour moves on its own card, you may ride along.

cards.name: Memory Swap
cards.text: Draw three, then stack three from your hand back on top in any order.

cards.name: Overclocked
cards.text: A free Move 2, either side of your card.

cards.name: Piercing Drill
cards.text: The next robot you shove takes damage and is spun to face wherever you like.

cards.name: Pressure Release
cards.text: Reverse up to five squares, stopping short of anybody in the way.

cards.name: Re-Initialize
cards.text: Hand the Priority Token to anyone you choose.

cards.name: Recharge
cards.text: Three Energy, at once.

cards.name: Rewire
cards.text: Take every face-down Haywire out of your registers and programme them where you like.

cards.name: Switch
cards.text: Trade places with a neighbour, both of you keeping your facing.

cards.name: Zoop
cards.text: Spin on the spot to face any direction.
